name: self-expression
description: self-expression plugin for agents like claude opus, codex, gemini, and deepseek
author: John Haugeland <stonecypher@gmail.com>

scripts.terser: node src/build_js/minify_bundles.js && cp dist/index.iife.js dist/index.iife.js.map docs
scripts.dts: cp build/ts/*.d.ts build/ts/*.d.ts.map dist/ && mkdir -p dist/charts && cp build/ts/charts/*.d.ts build/ts/charts/*.d.ts.map dist/charts/ && mkdir -p dist/diagrams && cp build/ts/diagrams/*.d.ts build/ts/diagrams/*.d.ts.map dist/diagrams/ && mkdir -p dist/raster && cp build/ts/raster/*.d.ts build/ts/raster/*.d.ts.map dist/raster/
scripts.site: cp src/html/* docs && cp src/html/.nojekyll docs && cp README.md docs/ && cp dist/index.mjs docs/docs/ && cp src/html/*.png docs/docs
scripts.just_test: vitest run --coverage && vitest run --config vitest-stoch.config.ts --coverage && vitest run --config vitest-stoch.mutat.ts --coverage
scripts.changelog: rm -f CHANGELOG.md && rm -f CHANGELOG.long.md && rm -f ./src/doc_md/CHANGELOG.md && rm -f ./src/doc_md/CHANGELOG.long.md && better_git_changelog -b && cp CHANGELOG.* ./src/doc_md/
scripts.ci: echo starting && node -e "console.log(new Date().toLocaleString())" && npm run build -- --profile=ci && echo finishing && node -e "console.log(new Date().toLocaleString())"
